subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

__Seldom__ had he been so joyous in other's happiness.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Frequently **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seldom **means rarely or not often. (शायद ही कभी या अक्सर नहीं)

 
 
• **For example**: *She seldom visits that cafe, preferring other places to hang out.*
 
 
 
• Therefore the antonym would be **frequently**.
 
• The word **frequently **means happening often or regularly. (अक्सर या नियमित रूप से हो रहा है)
 
 
• **For example**: *He frequently goes jogging in the park to stay active.*
 
 
 
• Other possible antonyms for seldom could be often, regularly, or frequently.

Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hardly **is a synonym of seldom, meaning almost not at all or rarely. (लगभग बिल्कुल नहीं या शायद ही कभी)
 
• **Rarely **is a synonym of seldom, meaning not often or infrequently. (अक्सर नहीं या यदा-कदा)
 
• **Occasionally **means happening from time to time or occasionally, but is not the opposite of seldom. (समय-समय पर या कभी-कभार होता रहता है)
